meta.title: Acknowledgements — ShrimpPulse
meta.description: Acknowledgements for ShrimpPulse: knowledge-base review by {{people.reviewer}}, Kasetsart University, and partnership with the {{people.taa}} and the {{people.taba}}.

hero.title: The people and organisations behind ShrimpPulse 2.0
hero.lead: ShrimpPulse would not exist without the specialists and industry organisations who reviewed, tested, and advised on it. This page records that cooperation accurately.

sections.title: {{people.reviewer}}
sections.text: The pharmacological knowledge base of ShrimpPulse was curated and reviewed by {{people.reviewer}} of the {{people.reviewerAffiliation}}. This review covers the knowledge base that the system retrieves from; individual AI responses are generated by the system and are not each reviewed by a veterinarian.

sections.title: {{people.taa}} and {{people.taba}}
sections.role: Partners in the development of ShrimpPulse 2.0
sections.text: ShrimpPulse 2.0 was developed in partnership with both the {{people.taa}} and the {{people.taba}}.

sections.title: {{people.prakob}}
sections.text: Initial field testing for ShrimpPulse 2.0 was conducted through an on-site visit to the farm of {{people.prakob}}, President of the {{people.taa}} and an experienced member of the shrimp farming industry.

sections.title: {{people.soraphat}}
sections.text: I also met with {{people.soraphat}}, President of the {{people.taba}}, to brief him on developments and possible distribution strategies in a commercial setting.

photos.farmAlt: On-site field testing of ShrimpPulse 2.0 at a shrimp farm.

closing.title: A note of thanks
closing.text: To every farmer who has asked ShrimpPulse a question and told us what was useful and what was not: the project's direction is set largely by you. Thank you.
